features.title: AWS EKS cluster is provisioned with Terraform
features.user_visible_behavior: A cloud engineer can run Terraform to create the VPC, EKS cluster, managed node group, ECR repository, and PostgreSQL database required by the platform.
verification: Run terraform init -backend=false and terraform validate successfully.
Confirm terraform plan renders the VPC, EKS cluster, node group, ECR repository, and RDS instance.
Confirm outputs expose cluster name, endpoint, and database endpoint.
evidence: ./scripts/verify-terraform.sh: fmt, init -backend=false, and validate passed
terraform fmt -check -recursive: no changes required
terraform init -backend=false: AWS provider 6.71.0 installed; lock file committed
terraform validate: configuration valid
credentialed terraform plan: Plan: 35 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy
plan includes the VPC, two public and two private subnets, NAT gateway, EKS cluster, managed node group, ECR repository, RDS PostgreSQL 15 instance, IAM roles, security groups, and outputs
plan without TF_VAR_db_password: exit 1, no value for required variable, no resources created
plan with node_desired_size=5: exit 1, precondition rejects a value outside the 1-3 bounds
openspec validate provision-aws-eks-terraform --strict: Change is valid
No terraform apply was run and no AWS resources were created; deployment remains pending explicit approval
docker compose ps and GET http://localhost:8080/health: local stack still healthy with 200 {"status":"ok"}
